meet_prof: Visit Professor Arth's Money Lab, north-west of the square.
open_account: Open an account at Paisapur Bank, east of the Lab.
get_docs: Get your KYC documents from Mom at home.
back_to_bank: Take your documents to Meena Rao at the bank.
tell_mom: Go home and tell Mom the news.
buyer_outside: Someone wants to buy your old cycle. They're outside.
meena_challenge: Take Meena Rao's challenge at the bank.
ch2_prof: See Professor Arth at the Lab.
ch2_month: Buy this month's needs at Zaroorat Store, then sleep at home.
ch2_pyf: Professor Arth has a saving trick for you. Visit the Lab.
ch2_month2: Live through one more month on your budget.
anwar_challenge: Take Anwar Chacha's challenge at Zaroorat Store.
ch3_home: Go home and rest. You've earned it.
ch3_lakshmi: Find Lakshmi Aunty in the town square.
ch3_fund: Save 3 months of needs in the bank, then take Lakshmi Aunty's challenge.
lakshmi_challenge: You have a safety net! Take Lakshmi Aunty's challenge.
ch4_prof: See Professor Arth about your big goal.
ch4_compare: Compare loans: Mr. Iyer at the bank and the moneylender's house.
ch4_iyer: Live with your choices for two months, then take Mr. Iyer's challenge at the bank.
ch5_prof: See Professor Arth. Something big is happening in town.
ch5_bonds: Buy a town bond at the Bond Office, north of the main road.
ch5_sleep: Sleep at home. The bridge will be ready next month.
ch5_exchange: Cross the new bridge and visit the Deccan Exchange.
ch5_invest: Invest a little, stay invested until month 10, then take Ravi Sharma's challenge.
ch6_prof: See Professor Arth. Something is wrong in Deccan City.
ch6_report: Report Double Dhamaka to Inspector Fatima at the Cyber Cell.
end: Visit Professor Arth for your year-end review.
new_goal: Keep saving for your new goal. Check progress in your MENU wallet.
